title: After the Debut: The Lingering Scent of Turf

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: This superbly talented Umamusume has claimed first place in her debut race! What a bold performance right from the get-go!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (I can still feel it—the intensity of those final moments, the rush of crossing the finish line…)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Aha… Ahaha! So this is what a race is like! This is how the turf feels under my feet!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Little Sisters
text_block_list.text: Hey, big sis! You were incredible!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Cassie! Polly!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Did you… see that? I gave it all I had…

text_block_list.name: Ines's Little Sisters
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It was so exciting! Ooooh! We still kinda feel…

text_block_list.name: Ines's Little Sisters
text_block_list.text: Amaaazing!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe, no doubt! Huff… I feel the… same!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (I mean, my heart is still pounding like crazy!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (I wouldn't be surprised if the people around me could hear it beating…)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (It feels just like the day when I first experienced that feeling.)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on TV
text_block_list.text: "Since I was born an Umamusume, I always felt it was my calling to become a Derby champion."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I still remember it so clearly—I was doing laundry, and I'd just finished hanging up my sister's hoodie to dry when I saw the Japanese Derby broadcast live on TV.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Despite being covered in mud, the Derby champion was smiling happily amidst the thunderous applause.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I remember the hanger in my hand making a clang as it hit the floor.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: After the broadcast was over, I rushed over to a nearby secondhand bookstore.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I picked up a magazine I'd had my eye on for a while—the Derby special feature issue.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: And just like that, I stood there reading it until the sun went down, my heart thumping noisily the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Interview Transcript
text_block_list.text: "For us Umamusume, there's one title that we all dream of acquiring."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I've never forgotten those words…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Not even once, since the day I read them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Once the race is over, we see Ines Fujin's little sisters off before making our way back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thoughts begin roaming around in my head as I consider which Open race we should enter next based on her performance today.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I want to take on the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That's right! I want to win the Derby! I want to feel all the excitement that comes with competing on that grand stage!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It's something all Umamusume dream of, and I'm no exception. I'm going to enter it…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: And I'm going to win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her keen enthusiasm takes me by surprise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In stark contrast to the soft warmth she had radiated previously, her eyes now appear to be burning with a fierce intensity.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Tell me, Trainer—how can I reach that point? What is it that I need?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The things she lacks, first and foremost, are experience and racing instinct.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The quickest way to establish those qualities would be to have her compete in a G1 race where Umamusume vie for the title of junior champion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For example, a race like the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes…
choice_data_list: (…Can we really aim for a G1 race right off the bat?)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm a newbie trainer, and she's an Umamusume who only just made her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Junior year G1 races are filled with Umamusume who boast incredible innate talent. And many have been honing their skills since a young age.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Considering our current level, it might be an overly ambitious goal.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Which race should I enter next?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, I need to meet her determined gaze with a direct challenge.
choice_data_list: Want to shoot for the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes?
Want to shoot for the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Gotcha! The Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes it is! We'd better start preparing right away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Upon hearing her response, I steel my own resolve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes is a 1,600-meter race on turf, where competitors vie for the title of junior year champion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We'll use it as a stepping stone on her way to the winning the Derby.
